scenes.title: Higher pressure raises the boiling point
Hotter water and steam cook faster

vo.text: This pressure cooker cooks faster by making water boil at a higher temperature.
vo.speak: This pressure cooker cooks faster by making water boil at a higher temperature.

vo.text: Its sealed lid traps steam, so pressure builds above the food.
vo.speak: Its sealed lid traps steam, so pressure builds above the food.

vo.text: Heating turns some water into steam inside the limited space.
vo.speak: Heating turns some water into steam inside the limited space.

vo.text: The regulator holds the pressure at its designed cooking level.
vo.speak: The regulator holds the pressure at its designed cooking level.

vo.text: At that higher pressure, water can stay liquid beyond its normal boiling point.
vo.speak: At that higher pressure, water can stay liquid beyond its normal boiling point.

vo.text: The hotter water and steam transfer energy into food more quickly.
vo.speak: The hotter water and steam transfer energy into food more quickly.

vo.text: A locking lid and safety valve help control excess pressure, and the cooker must depressurize before opening.
vo.speak: A locking lid and safety valve help control excess pressure, and the cooker must depressurize before opening.

vo.text: So trapped steam raises the boiling temperature, and the hotter cooking medium speeds up the meal.
